targets.title: Effects of Voice Pitch on Social Perceptions Vary With Relational Mobility and Homicide Rate
targets.evidence_quote:
In the present report, we test whether the main results and claims made by the
authors are computationally reproducible.
targets.outcome_computational_quote:
We find that the
main findings could be reproduced successfully and that they hold even when using a
modelling approach based on the frequentist framework.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote:
Overall, the results from the frequentist models are very
similar to the results from the Bayesian models and do not change the interpretation
advanced by the authors (see Table 2).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors judge computation successful despite small interval discrepancies and explicitly judge the frequentist robustness analysis substantively consistent.
